headline: Visible Growth with Unfactored Optionality.

highlights: Gross Profit stood at INR 1,438mn (+16.8% YoY/-0.5% QoQ); below our estimates of INR 1,493mn; Gross margins contracted by 701 bps YoY (-314 bps QoQ) to 48.7% in Q2FY27.
EBITDA stood at INR 1,064mn (+16.2% YoY/-1.6% QoQ); below our estimates of INR 1,127mn.
EBITDA margin contracted by 543 bps YoY (-276 bps QoQ) to 36% in Q2FY27.
Project-based operations and equipment transition caused ~300-400 bps margin impact.
valuation: Capital Discipline and Optionality Across Adjacent Energy Verticals: Deep's charter hire model, with no upfront operator capital, is winning share as domestic gas monetization accelerates, while the ~80-compressor fleet (~85% of India's outsourced compression) offers ~25-35% segment growth with abnormal upside if outsourcing penetration moves from ~30% to ~40%.
Outlook & Valuation: Deep Industries enters H2FY27 with strong momentum, backed by an order book of ~INR 30.89bn that secures over ~90% of FY28E growth and a bidding pipeline of ~INR 7-8bn.

Management guides ~30-35% revenue growth in both FY27E and FY28E, with PAT of ~INR 3.5-3.7bn in FY27 rising to ~ INR 4.7-5.0bn in FY28E, and annual EBITDA margins of ~42-43% with upside from higher-margin PEC and Dolphin Offshore contributions.
watch: Key Highlights Structural Growth Runway Backed by Policy and Order Book Visibility: Deep Industries is positioned at the centre of India's aggressive pivot from revenue-sharing to an exploration- first agenda.
PEC and Dolphin to Drive Margin Mix Upgrade from H2FY27: The 15-year, ~INR 14.02bn ONGC production enhancement contract is the key near-term catalyst.
